title: China Price Check: $95 Antelope Canyon or $13 Rainbow Hills? | China Travel Expert
description:
One canyon costs about $95 to walk. One costs about $13. Same kind of rainbow rock — which do you book?

To see Upper Antelope Canyon in Arizona you have to book a Navajo-guided tour, and those run roughly $95 and up per person before the permit fee. To see China's rainbow mountains at Zhangye Danxia in Gansu, the all-in combo ticket — park entry plus the mandatory sightseeing shuttle — is about ¥93, close to $13. Both are ticketed access to a world-famous, colorful rock landscape; the price gap is real.

🧭 Expert Tip: at Zhangye Danxia, come about 90 minutes before sunset — low light makes the mineral stripes glow far more than harsh midday sun.
